titre: Aux États-Unis, la responsabilité civile se renchérit pendant que les biens s'effondrent
sous_titre: Variation des prix de l'assurance d'entreprise aux États-Unis, deuxième trimestre 2026, en %
categories: Resp. civile hors accidents du travail

Biens.texte: Double-digit decreases were recorded in five regions: IMEA (19%); Pacific (15%); LAC (14%); the US (13%); and the UK (11%).

Ensemble des branches.texte: The overall composite rate in the US – which declined by 1% in Q1 2026 – fell by 2% in Q2 2026.

Lignes financières et professionnelles.texte: Rate reductions were recorded across all regions except the US, where rates increased by 1%

Responsabilité civile.texte: the US, where casualty rates increased by 7% (9% in Q1).
